specialRules.name: Seven Deadly Sins
specialRules.summary: Before recruiting, dedicate the warband to Wrath, Envy, Lust, Pride, Sloth, Gluttony or Greed: in the builder, pick that sin's list. The standard list shows only the powers open to every warband.

specialRules.name: Goetic Powers
specialRules.summary: ELITE models can have Goetic Powers (abilities and spells), as many as their entry says. Spells are paid for in BLOOD MARKERS from any models without CULT or DEMONIC, anywhere; no Success Roll; the same spell at most once per Activation.

specialRules.name: Belly of the Beast (Ability)
specialRules.summary: a Melee Attack that places BLOOD MARKERS on it gives the attacker 1 BLOOD MARKER.

specialRules.name: Eater of the Flesh (Ability)
specialRules.summary: after its Melee Attack remove 1 BLOOD MARKER from itself per marker placed on the target (not CULT or DEMONIC targets). Praetors & Sorcerers only.

specialRules.name: Uncaring Gluttony (Spell, cost 2)
specialRules.summary: Cast Spell ACTION: one piece of Equipment of an enemy that has not Activated is unusable for the game.
